protocol.input: Unmodified publisher RescaleT(320) and ToTensorLab(flag=0), full original EXIF-oriented RGB. No corner, mask or ROI input.
protocol.output: Keep the publisher fused sigmoid head and per-image min/max normalization. No change of threshold, preprocessing or crop policy.
protocol.pipeline: Keep every production crop. Only if none exists, accept an outline-supported neural proposal with observed rectified overlap >=99% and maximum axis-normalized extrapolation <=5%, always needs_review. Use analytic projective coverage; no mask score or template selects the crop.

scope: Fixed-budget outline-supervision experiment on the same 24 reviewed training photos. Same fresh publisher initialization, 180 draws, synthetic data, optimizer, late-encoder adaptation, normalization and final checkpoint as the saved encoder model. Only an explicit known-outline auxiliary loss is added. Additional loss computation means this is not an exactly equal-compute trial. Training-band metrics are diagnostic and do not establish crop or reconstruction improvement. Native development only; no browser parity or production-release claim.
